content:
Ava: ok team small victory — turned my WFH nook into a 'focus cave' to stop zoom fatigue. lights, projector, mic, and yes, the router is now in a shoebox behind plants. pic: https://i.imgur.com/abc1234.jpg :evergreen_tree: :sparkles:

michael: omg that looks like an indie coffee shop. what's the projector?

Ava: it's a C9 pico I scavenged from an old review. 480p but the ambient light setup makes it dreamy.

taylor: can you post the angle? thinking about projecting docs while coding.

Ava: here's a quick snap of my desk angle: https://i.imgur.com/def5678.jpg

nora: router in a shoebox 😂 did you lose wifi?

Ava: nope, just moved it into the shoebox with a USB fan — slightly warmer but still fine. had to restart mesh once.

infra-bot: Notice: brief packet loss detected at 1799004380 UTC for Ava-home via ISP-Fastwave. 4 dropped pings.

michael: re: mesh restart — what's your command? I always forget.

Ava: ssh pi@home-router 'sudo systemctl restart wg-quick@wg0' worked for me. (I run a wireguard edge node)

taylor: love the setup. 10/10 would attend a remote focus cave party.

nora: unsolicited advice: add a cheap surge protector and a sticky cable label. saved my life.

Ava: noted! also accepting lamp recs. low-blue light, warm tone.

michael: ikea dimmable work lamp, very cheap and dimmable via touch.

Ava: thanks y'all. next time I try a 'projector + white sheet' wallpaper hack and report back. :camera_with_flash:
